title: How Long Will Europe Support Ukraine?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带300件你最珍贵的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台变成一个像是由美丽50年历史老物件组成的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自奥彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔维尔尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《日报》。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, Western leaders at the G7 summit in Germany have publicly recommitted themselves to supporting Ukraine in its war against Russia.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，西方领导人在德国七国集团峰会上公开重新承诺支持乌克兰抗击俄罗斯的战争。

sentences.en: But behind the scenes, European officials are beginning to have a very different conversation about how the war ends and what Ukraine might have to give up to get there.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，欧洲官员开始就战争如何结束以及乌克兰可能不得不放弃什么来换取和平，展开完全不同的对话。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Matina Steves-Gridneuf on the change underway in Europe and what it means for the future of the war.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事玛蒂娜·斯蒂夫斯-格里德讷夫将讲述欧洲正在发生的变化及其对战争未来的意义。
zh_words: 玛蒂娜·斯蒂夫斯-格里德讷夫

sentences.en: It's Thursday, June 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月30日，星期四。

sentences.en: Matina, when Russia first invaded Ukraine, remind us how European leaders reacted.
sentences.zh: 玛蒂娜，当俄罗斯最初入侵乌克兰时，提醒一下我们欧洲领导人是如何反应的？

sentences.en: Well, within hours of the invasion, European leaders convened an emergency meeting here in Brussels to figure out what to do in response.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在入侵发生几小时内，欧洲领导人在布鲁塞尔召开了紧急会议，以商讨如何应对。

sentences.en: And I remember in the flurry of activity that they had to all rush to Brussels from their country.
sentences.zh: 我记得在一片混乱中，他们不得不从各自国家紧急赶往布鲁塞尔。

sentences.en: So the meeting started quite late and sort of quite unusually.
sentences.zh: 所以会议开始得相当晚，而且有些不同寻常。

sentences.en: Literally, they met in complete telecommunication blackout.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，他们是在完全电信屏蔽的情况下开会的。

sentences.en: So they didn't have their phones or any other devices in the room with them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的房间里没有手机或任何其他设备。

sentences.en: And in that meeting, President Volodymyr Zelensky, the Ukrainian leader, joined the EU leaders by teleconference.
sentences.zh: 在那次会议上，乌克兰领导人、总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基通过电话会议加入了欧盟领导人的行列。

sentences.en: And it was, by all accounts, a really remarkable moment.
sentences.zh: 据各方反映，那确实是一个非常了不起的时刻。

sentences.en: He was in a bunker wearing this green T-shirt that he's become famous for and was very emotional and said,
sentences.zh: 他身处地下掩体，穿着让他名声大噪的那件绿色T恤，情绪非常激动，并说道：

sentences.en: this may be the last time you see me alive and I need your help because this isn't just a fight for my country.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我活着的最后一次见到你们了，我需要你们的帮助，因为这不仅是为了我的国家而战。

sentences.en: Ukraine, it's a fight for Europe.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰，这是为了欧洲而战。

sentences.en: And based on what my sources told me, this was a message that really resonated and moved European leaders to tears.
sentences.zh: 根据我的消息来源告诉我的，这个信息真正引起了共鸣，并让欧洲领导人感动得流泪。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Early this morning, Russian troops invaded Ukraine, a free and sovereign country.
sentences.zh: 今天一早，俄罗斯军队入侵了乌克兰这个自由主权国家。

sentences.en: After that meeting, the president of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, held a press conference.
sentences.zh: 会议结束后，欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: We condemn this barbaric attack.
sentences.zh: 我们谴责这一野蛮行径。

sentences.en: It is President Putin who is bringing war back to Europe.
sentences.zh: 是普京总统把战争带回了欧洲。

sentences.en: And she really sort of leaned into this idea that this fight wasn't just sort of Russia being aggressive over territory.
sentences.zh: 她确实倾向于这样一种观点，即这场战斗不仅仅是俄罗斯对领土的侵略。

sentences.en: It was about something much bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 这是一场比这更宏大的事情。

sentences.en: Russian's target is not only Donbass.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的目标不仅是顿巴斯。

sentences.en: The target is not only Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 目标不仅是乌克兰。

sentences.en: The target is the stability in Europe and the whole of the international peace order.
sentences.zh: 目标是欧洲的稳定和整个国际和平秩序。

sentences.en: And what became clear from my conversations with sources at the time was that this was the moment where this sort of moral clarity was instilled within European leaders,
sentences.zh: 从我当时与消息人士的交谈中可以清楚看出，正是这一刻在欧洲领导人心中注入了这种道德清晰度，

sentences.en: that this was a fight for good.
sentences.zh: 即这是一场正义之战。

sentences.en: It was a fight not just to support Ukraine, but it was a fight for Europe and Europe's future against an aggressive Russia.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是为了支持乌克兰而战，更是为了欧洲以及欧洲的未来，对抗一个侵略性的俄罗斯。

sentences.en: The European Union stands with Ukraine and its people.
sentences.zh: 欧盟坚定地与乌克兰及其人民站在一起。

sentences.en: We will continue to support them.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续支持他们。

sentences.en: Ukraine will prevail.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰必将胜利。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And can you lay out specifically what the EU leaders decided to do?
sentences.zh: 你能具体说明一下欧盟领导人决定做什么吗？

sentences.en: From that point on, in really an unprecedented display of unity, EU leaders put in place the most far-reaching,
sentences.zh: 从那时起，欧盟领导人以前所未有的团结姿态，实施了

sentences.en: the most expansive economic sanctions against Russia that the bloc has ever taken in its history.
sentences.zh: 该集团历史上最深远、最广泛的对俄经济制裁。

sentences.en: They start unplugging the very deep and complex economic relationship between Europe and Russia, which runs in the hundreds of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们开始切断欧洲与俄罗斯之间价值数千亿美元的极其深厚且复杂的经济关系。

sentences.en: And they do this just in the course of three months, ultimately banning imports of Russian oil,
sentences.zh: 他们在短短三个月内做到了这一点，最终禁止进口俄罗斯石油，

sentences.en: a measure that was considered unimaginable because Europe so depends on Russian oil for its industry and for its economic engine.
sentences.zh: 这一举措曾被认为不可想象，因为欧洲的工业和经济引擎非常依赖俄罗斯石油。

sentences.en: These are very, very difficult decisions to make, not least because the European economies are already on shaky ground at the back of COVID.
sentences.zh: 做出这些决定非常非常困难，尤其是因为在新冠疫情之后，欧洲经济已经处于动摇的基础之上。

sentences.en: We have high inflation, high energy prices.
sentences.zh: 我们有高通胀、高能源价格。

sentences.en: And so sticking together to take these measures is additionally difficult.
sentences.zh: 因此，团结一致采取这些措施更加困难。

sentences.en: And yet the Europeans do it because they are really quite unwavering in their support of Ukraine against Russia.
sentences.zh: 然而，欧洲人还是这样做了，因为他们对乌克兰对抗俄罗斯的支持坚定不移。

sentences.en: And of course, in those days as well, Ukraine was winning, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，在那几天里，乌克兰也在取胜，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, all of these battles, we thought Russia would be the conqueror, but it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有这些战役，我们以为俄罗斯会是征服者，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And Ukraine really became this kind of little engine that could country in the war.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰确实在这场战争中成为了那种“能行的小火车”式国家。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think Europeans really admired that and were inspired by that.
sentences.zh: 我想欧洲人真的很钦佩这一点，并深受鼓舞。

sentences.en: Watching the underdog sort of hold its own and defend itself against sort of aggressive, massive Russia was very inspiring for a lot of Europeans.
sentences.zh: 看着弱者坚守阵地，抵御侵略成性、庞大的俄罗斯，对许多欧洲人来说非常鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: It also was completely outside expectations.
sentences.zh: 这也完全超出了预期。

sentences.en: I remember in the early days, people said Ukraine would fall in two days and it just didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 我记得在早期，人们说乌克兰会在两天内沦陷，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But of course, as the war went on, Russia starts to concentrate its energy on the Eastern Front, where it makes a lot of advances and it starts taking territory.
sentences.zh: 但当然，随着战争的继续，俄罗斯开始将精力集中在东线，在那里取得了很大进展并开始占领领土。

sentences.en: And Ukraine starts to struggle and lose lots of soldiers and really is having a hard time at this point in the war.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰开始苦苦挣扎，失去大量士兵，在战争的这个阶段确实举步维艰。

sentences.en: So as this shift starts happening, what are you hearing from your sources?
sentences.zh: 因此，随着这种转变的发生，你从消息人士那里听到了什么？

sentences.en: I think with the way the war evolved, exactly as you described, European leaders that were first in the sort of trance of decisiveness and emotion to make decisions,
sentences.zh: 我认为随着战争的演变，正如你所描述的那样，最初处于果断和情感决策狂热中的欧洲领导人，

sentences.en: they begin to slow down.
sentences.zh: 他们开始放慢脚步。

sentences.en: The costs of the war to them begin to crystallize.
sentences.zh: 战争对他们的代价开始显现。

sentences.en: This is an incredibly costly endeavor for the Europeans.
sentences.zh: 这对欧洲人来说是一项代价高昂的举动。

sentences.en: The support, military support, resources supporting Ukrainian refugees, but also the cost of the sanctions against Russia in terms of energy prices and rising inflation.
sentences.zh: 支持、军事支持、支持乌克兰难民的资源，以及制裁俄罗斯在能源价格和通货膨胀上升方面的代价。

sentences.en: These are huge, huge costs.
sentences.zh: 这些都是极其巨大的代价。

sentences.en: And the war is dragging on for longer than they had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 而且战争拖延的时间比他们预期的要长。

sentences.en: And I start hearing from European leaders, but also less senior people working on this day in, day out, a sense of fatigue, a sense of wanting to regain control of the future,
sentences.zh: 我开始听到欧洲领导人，以及日复一日从事这项工作的资历较浅的人，流露出疲惫感，想要重新掌控未来的感觉，

sentences.en: a reticence to continue carrying the costs for the war in Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 对继续承担乌克兰战争代价的抗拒，

sentences.en: and an eagerness for some predictability to be restored and ultimately for some kind of peace.
sentences.zh: 以及渴望恢复某种可预测性并最终获得某种和平的急切心情。

sentences.en: I recently had a conversation with a top European diplomat, and he said to me, my people won't sacrifice jobs for the Donbass.
sentences.zh: 我最近与一位欧洲高级外交官交谈过，他对我说，我的民众不会为了顿巴斯而牺牲工作。

sentences.en: A real punch, a real way of saying, I'm not going to see my economy decimated so that Ukraine can hold on to its eastern flank.
sentences.zh: 这真是有力的一击，换句话说就是，我不会看着我的经济被摧毁，只为了让乌克兰保住其东翼。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is some European leaders want to shift the conversation away from military support and towards a pause in the fighting, basically some kind of peace.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，一些欧洲领导人希望将话题从军事支持转移到暂停战斗上，基本上是某种形式的和平。

sentences.en: How is that conversation unfolding?
sentences.zh: 这种对话是如何展开的？

sentences.en: Well, that's the thing, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关键就在这里，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: I mean, for a while, European leaders weren't really having an open conversation about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一段时间，欧洲领导人并没有真正公开谈论这件事。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, I guess it's not seen as diplomatically polite or correct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这在外交上被认为是不礼貌或不正确的。

sentences.en: It sort of goes back to the beginning of our conversation that the sort of moral and rhetorical framework around the war was this fight between good and evil.
sentences.zh: 这有点回到我们对话的开始，即围绕战争的道德和修辞框架是善与恶之间的战斗。

sentences.en: And that worked in favor of European politicians who were rallying voters and rallying their own resources to support Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这有利于那些动员选民和自身资源来支持乌克兰的欧洲政客。

sentences.en: And they really invested in that kind of dichotomy.
sentences.zh: 他们确实投入了这种二分法中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's hard to go against good.
sentences.zh: 很难与正义作对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's hard to go against that thing that you called good and noble and worthy and suddenly say, well, it's still good, but it's a bit complicated.
sentences.zh: 很难违背你所称的正义、高尚和有价值的事物，突然说，嗯，它仍然是正义的，但有点复杂。

sentences.en: That nuance is very difficult to capture publicly.
sentences.zh: 这种细微差别很难在公开场合表达出来。

sentences.en: And we really saw a test case of that earlier this month when France's president, Emmanuel Macron,
sentences.zh: 本月初我们就看到了这样一个测试案例，当时法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙

sentences.en: went on the record and said that he would like his country to play the role of a mediator to Russia in the future.
sentences.zh: 公开表示，他希望自己的国家未来在对俄关系中扮演调解人的角色。

sentences.en: And in order to bring Russia back to the negotiating table at some point, humiliating Russia in Ukraine must be avoided.
sentences.zh: 为了在某个时候让俄罗斯重返谈判桌，必须避免在乌克兰羞辱俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And the response to that statement was really brutal.
sentences.zh: 对这一言论的反应确实非常残酷。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian foreign minister, for example, said that it sort of brought humiliation against France itself and any other country that would call for avoiding humiliating Russia.
sentences.zh: 例如，乌克兰外长表示，这给法国本身以及任何呼吁避免羞辱俄罗斯的国家带来了耻辱。

sentences.en: So that sort of showed what a delicate discussion to have in public this is.
sentences.zh: 所以这表明在公开场合进行这种讨论是多么微妙。

sentences.en: But still, that discussion has intensified in recent days.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，最近几天这种讨论还是加剧了。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, for example,
sentences.zh: 嗯，例如，

sentences.en: a top advisor to the German chancellor just this past week went to a public event and spoke more about why people should be concerned about Germany's future relationship with Russia.
sentences.zh: 就在过去一周，德国总理的一位高级顾问出席了一个公开活动，并更多地谈到了为什么人们应该关注德国与俄罗斯未来的关系。

sentences.en: And behind closed doors, we've also been hearing from diplomats who are becoming more exasperated,
sentences.zh: 在闭门会议中，我们也听到外交官们变得越来越恼火，

sentences.en: sort of somewhat frankly sounding fed up with Ukraine's constant demands for more support, especially more weapons and so on.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，听起来有点受够了乌克兰不断要求更多支持，尤其是更多武器等等。

sentences.en: And when will this stop?
sentences.zh: 而这何时会停止？

sentences.en: These are not the types of words you would hear from European diplomats mouths just two months ago.
sentences.zh: 这些都不是两个月前你会从欧洲外交官口中听到的话。

sentences.en: So does all of Europe feel this way?
sentences.zh: 所以整个欧洲都这么觉得吗？

sentences.en: No, not at all, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也不，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Not all of Europe agrees that the conversation should be changing.
sentences.zh: 并非所有欧洲人都认为对话应该改变。

sentences.en: On the contrary, Poland and some other Eastern European countries, especially the Baltic states,
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，波兰和其他一些东欧国家，尤其是波罗的海国家，

sentences.en: these are countries that either have borders with Russia or a lot of shared experience of having been annexed in Soviet times and so on.
sentences.zh: 这些国家要么与俄罗斯接壤，要么在苏联时期有被吞并等大量共同经历。

sentences.en: They are squarely behind Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 它们坚决支持乌克兰。

sentences.en: They sense Russian aggression so much more closely and existentially to themselves, and they are not prepared to abandon Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 它们更密切、更具生存意义地感受到俄罗斯的侵略，它们没有准备好抛弃乌克兰。

sentences.en: They want to continue fighting for exactly the same goals as Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 它们希望继续为与乌克兰完全相同的目标而战。

sentences.en: However, even the bigger countries we were talking about earlier, they're not suggesting abandoning Ukraine or permitting it to just sort of drift and be surrendered to Russia.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使是我们之前讨论过的较大国家，它们也没有建议抛弃乌克兰或允许其任由俄罗斯摆布并投降。

sentences.en: That's not their goal.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们的目标。

sentences.en: I think the better way of framing it is that they would like to shift the conversation to be able to talk about pausing the war,
sentences.zh: 我认为更好的说法是，他们希望将话题转向能够讨论暂停战争，

sentences.en: bringing Zelensky on a conversation about where he might be prepared to draw the line,
sentences.zh: 让泽连斯基参与讨论他准备在哪里划清界限，

sentences.en: to not govern some of Ukraine's territory for a while so that they can focus on consolidation and focus on making some peacetime efforts as well.
sentences.zh: 暂时不管理乌克兰的部分领土，以便他们能够专注于巩固内部，也专注于开展一些和平时期的努力。

sentences.en: Okay, and if that new conversation is going to be about winding down the war and potentially losing territory, how willing is Zelensky to have that conversation?
sentences.zh: 好的，如果这个新对话是关于结束战争并可能失去领土，泽连斯基进行这种对话的意愿有多强？

sentences.en: Well, he's sort of ready to have it in a sort of abstract sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在某种抽象意义上已经准备好进行了。

sentences.en: Like, for example, this week, he said at the G7, the summit of the largest developed economies, he dialed in and said that he wants the fighting to be over by winter.
sentences.zh: 比如，本周他在七国集团（最大发达经济体峰会）上表示，他通过电话连线说他希望在冬天前结束战斗。

sentences.en: But he also said that he wants more support from his Western allies.
sentences.zh: 但他也表示希望西方盟友给予更多支持。

sentences.en: He wants them to adopt more sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 他希望他们对俄罗斯采取更多制裁。

sentences.en: He wants them to give him more weapons to continue fighting.
sentences.zh: 他希望他们给他更多武器继续战斗。

sentences.en: So it's not entirely clear that he means that he wants to end the war and therefore he'll give up territory.
sentences.zh: 因此，并不完全清楚他是否意味着他想结束战争因而愿意放弃领土。

sentences.en: In fact, he seems convinced that there's still a path to victory for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他似乎坚信乌克兰仍然有一条通往胜利的道路。

sentences.en: That he can win this thing.
sentences.zh: 他能赢得这场战争。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: As long as he continues to get really vital military support from the Europeans and the Americans.
sentences.zh: 只要他继续从欧洲人和美国人那里获得真正至关重要的军事支持。

sentences.en: And he doesn't also want to send the message out that while he's fighting the war, he's also talking about a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 而且他也不想发出这样的信息：在打仗的同时，他也在谈论停火。

sentences.en: He's saying, I'm watching Russia taking over my country.
sentences.zh: 他在说，我看着俄罗斯占领我的国家。

sentences.en: I'm not going to be talking about peace.
sentences.zh: 我不会谈论和平。

sentences.en: I'm going to be fighting.
sentences.zh: 我要战斗。

sentences.en: Additionally, Sabrina, it does seem he's got his people behind him.
sentences.zh: 此外，萨布丽娜，他似乎确实得到了人民的支持。

sentences.en: I don't think the Ukrainian people from what we understand are prepared to stop fighting for the country.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，乌克兰人民并没有准备好停止为国家而战。

sentences.en: On the contrary, they want to keep fighting.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，他们想继续战斗。

sentences.en: And frankly, they're ready to keep dying to fight against Russia.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，他们准备继续流血牺牲来对抗俄罗斯。

sentences.en: OK, so if some European leaders are trying to shift the conversation and Zelensky has no interest in having that conversation, it sounds like they're just stuck.
sentences.zh: 好的，如果一些欧洲领导人正试图改变话题而泽连斯基对此毫无兴趣，听起来他们只是陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Well, you're right that it's a delicate balance to strike.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对，这是一个微妙的平衡。

sentences.en: But the Europeans do believe they have something they can use to push the conversation forward.
sentences.zh: 但欧洲人确实相信他们有可以用来推动对话向前发展的筹码。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《交易手册》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市《交易手册》峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的一些领袖，包括J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在NYTimes.com上免费直播精选采访，供任何人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download The New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，您可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So, Matina, you said that European leaders have something that they think will get Ukraine to temper their expectations about this war and start the Hiba piece.
sentences.zh: 那么，玛蒂娜，你刚才说欧洲领导人认为他们有办法让乌克兰调低对这场战争的期望并开始寻求和平。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's something Ukraine has long wanted, and that's the promise to eventually become a full member of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是乌克兰长期以来一直想要的东西，那就是最终成为欧盟正式成员的承诺。

sentences.en: Back in 2014, when we had the Ukrainian revolution, known as the Maidan revolution,
sentences.zh: 早在2014年我们经历被称为“广场革命”的乌克兰革命时，

sentences.en: people were flying European Union flags in their barricades as they tried to get rid of a leader that they saw as a Russian stooge.
sentences.zh: 人们在路障上挥舞着欧盟旗帜，试图驱逐他们眼中俄罗斯傀儡的领导人。

sentences.en: And that was such an important moment in Ukraine's history because it was a public expression of their firm belief that they belong with Europe, with the West,
sentences.zh: 乌克兰历史上曾有过这样一个极其重要的时刻，因为这是他们坚定信念的公开表达，即他们属于欧洲，属于西方，

sentences.en: and ultimately with the European Union and against Russia.
sentences.zh: 归根结底属于欧盟，并且反对俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And honestly, Sabrina, just mere weeks ago, that very concept seemed highly, highly unlikely.
sentences.zh: 老实说，萨布丽娜，就在几个星期前，这个概念看起来还是极其、极其不可能的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: For a number of reasons, one of them being that Ukraine was seen as completely unready to start negotiating joining the EU.
sentences.zh: 原因有很多，其中之一就是乌克兰被认为完全没有准备好开始谈判加入欧盟。

sentences.en: That's a process that takes years anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，这是一个需要多年的过程。

sentences.en: But Ukraine was seen as very corrupt.
sentences.zh: 但乌克兰被认为非常腐败。

sentences.en: Its economy was seen as quite immature.
sentences.zh: 其经济被认为相当不成熟。

sentences.en: Its institutions, its courts, all of these important things that European Union members focus on, reform to eventually join this bloc.
sentences.zh: 它的机构、它的法院，所有这些欧盟成员国关注并进行改革以最终加入这个集团的重要事务，

sentences.en: Ukraine was just seen as too far behind in that process to even aspire to becoming a candidate.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰在这一进程中被认为远远落后，甚至无法渴望成为候选国。

sentences.en: But at the end of last week, that's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 但在上周末结束时，这正是发生的事情。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I can be very brief because this is a very defining moment and a very good day for Europe today.
sentences.zh: 我可以简短地说，因为这对今天的欧洲来说是一个具有决定性的时刻，也是非常美好的一天。

sentences.en: I warmly congratulate President Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 我热烈祝贺泽连斯基总统。

sentences.en: They're being given EU candidate status.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了欧盟候选国地位。

sentences.en: There can be no better sign of hope for the citizens of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 对于乌克兰公民来说，再也没有比这更好的希望的标志了。

sentences.en: And what will candidacy actually mean for Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 获得候选国地位对乌克兰究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, look, Sabrina, it is a milestone, an important milestone, but it's mostly symbolic.
sentences.zh: 你看，萨布丽娜，这是一个里程碑，一个重要的里程碑，但它主要是象征性的。

sentences.en: They're not going to really become a fully-fledged member of the European Union anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 他们不会在短期内真正成为欧盟的正式成员。

sentences.en: Of course, the countries all have to do homework before moving to the next stage of the accession process.
sentences.zh: 当然，在进入加入进程的下一个阶段之前，这些国家都必须做作业。

sentences.en: Normally, that process lasts around 10 years, and those are 10 very difficult years.
sentences.zh: 通常，这个过程持续大约 10 年，这是非常艰难的 10 年。

sentences.en: They are focusing on reforms of sector by sector of the economy, upgrading the infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 他们正专注于经济各个部门的改革，升级基础设施，

sentences.en: really investing in reforming democratic institutions and making them function well to align themselves with the principles and the laws of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 真正投资于改革民主机构并使其运转良好，以使其与欧盟的原则和法律保持一致。

sentences.en: And it strengthens the European Union because it shows once again to the world that the European Union is united and strong in the face of external threats.
sentences.zh: 这也增强了欧盟的力量，因为它再次向世界表明，在面对外部威胁时，欧盟是团结和强大的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And so it can be a very long road.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是一条很长的路。

sentences.en: It could last longer than a decade, frankly, in the case of Ukraine, considering its starting point and the fact that it's still a country at war.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，就乌克兰而言，考虑到它的起点以及它仍然是一个处于战争中的国家这一事实，这可能会持续十年以上。

sentences.en: But it does mean that this is a real promise for Ukraine, that it is part of the European Union family, that it will one day become a fully-fledged member of the EU.
sentences.zh: 但这确实意味着，这对乌克兰是一个真正的承诺，即它是欧盟大家庭的一部分，它终将成为欧盟的正式成员。

sentences.en: And in the course of that promise, it will receive funding.
sentences.zh: 在兑现这一承诺的过程中，它将获得资金支持。

sentences.en: It will receive a lot of support from the European Union with expertise, things like economists and lawyers who can help Ukraine improve its policies and its institutions.
sentences.zh: 它将获得欧盟的大力支持，包括专业知识，例如可以帮助乌克兰改善政策和机构的经济学家和律师。

sentences.en: And just overall, Ukraine would just be so much more firmly tethered to the European Union system and standards.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，乌克兰将更加牢固地与欧盟系统和标准联系在一起。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, all of these things, really, you're describing stuff that would almost force a conversation about rebuilding, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有这些事情，实际上你所描述的几乎是在迫使人们就重建展开对话，对吧？

sentences.en: Because the benefits are about building roads, doing infrastructure, that type of thing.
sentences.zh: 因为好处是关于修建道路、建设基础设施之类的事情。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And there's a real sense here in Brussels among experts as well as politicians and diplomats that that's where the Europeans would like the conversation to be heading when we talk about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁塞尔的专家、政客和外交官中有一种真正的共识，即当我们谈论乌克兰时，欧洲人希望对话朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: They would like to be talking about reconstruction, investment, rebuilding, supporting Ukraine, more about the stuff that happens during peacetime and less about the war.
sentences.zh: 他们希望谈论重建、投资、再建、支持乌克兰，更多地谈论和平时期发生的事情，而不是战争。

sentences.en: So what does Zelensky think about all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么泽连斯基对这一切有何看法？

sentences.en: Well, he obviously thinks it's extremely significant.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他显然认为这意义重大。

sentences.en: And in fact, he said it's one of the most important decisions for Ukraine in its 30 years as a state.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他说这是乌克兰作为一个国家 30 年来最重要的决定之一。

sentences.en: But for him,
sentences.zh: 但对他来说，

sentences.en: that great development doesn't at all take away from the urgency and the pressing need for Europe to keep sending more weapons and more sophisticated weapons to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这一巨大进展丝毫没有减弱欧洲继续向乌克兰运送更多武器和更先进武器的紧迫性和迫切需求。

sentences.en: He clearly still demands those longer range missiles, for example, that he thinks can keep Ukraine on a path to victory.
sentences.zh: 他显然仍然要求那些例如更长程的导弹，他认为这些导弹可以使乌克兰保持通往胜利的道路。

sentences.en: So appreciative, though he may be, of being given candidate status for the European Union,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管他可能对被授予欧盟候选国地位表示感谢，

sentences.en: he's still very cognizant that he's fighting a war right now and needs more weapons right now.
sentences.zh: 但他仍然非常清楚自己现在正在打仗，现在就需要更多武器。

sentences.en: And one thing foreign policy experts and diplomats point out is that Zelensky does still have one very important card to play that would get him both more time to fight and could get him to convince Europe to give him more weapons.
sentences.zh: 外长政策专家和外交官指出的一点是，泽连斯基确实还有一张非常重要的牌可打，这张牌既能为他争取更多作战时间，又能说服欧洲向他提供更多武器。

sentences.en: What is that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: What's that card?
sentences.zh: 那是什么牌？

sentences.en: Well, Sabrina, there's something really interesting happening right now in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨布丽娜，乌克兰现在正在发生一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Ukraine, and it has to do with Ukraine's role as basically the breadbasket of the developing world in particular.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰，这与乌克兰作为特别是发展中世界的粮仓的角色有关。

sentences.en: Ukraine exports about 10 percent of the world's grains.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰出口大约世界 10% 的粮食。

sentences.en: And since the war started and because of the war, millions and millions of tons of grains have gotten stuck in these huge storage facilities in the port of Odessa.
sentences.zh: 自从战争开始以来，由于战争的原因，数百万吨的粮食被困在敖德萨港的这些巨大仓库里。

sentences.en: All the while, this shortage of grains is about to cause a famine in East Africa, is causing global food prices to rise.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这种粮食短缺即将导致东非发生饥荒，并正在导致全球食品价格上涨。

sentences.en: And there is a real global effort underway to find a way to release that grain from the port of Odessa and get it out onto global markets.
sentences.zh: 全球正在付出真正的努力，寻找方法将这些粮食从敖德萨港释放出来，并推向全球市场。

sentences.en: And the Europeans are just desperate, desperate to support that effort.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人非常、非常渴望支持这一努力。

sentences.en: But the thing is, operationally speaking, this is going to be really, really difficult to get the grain out of Odessa.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，从运营角度来看，将粮食运出敖德萨将非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: And the reason is that the port of Odessa has been mined.
sentences.zh: 原因在于敖德萨港已经布满了水雷。

sentences.en: The Ukrainians have placed mines all along so that they can protect themselves from a potential Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人到处都布下了水雷，以便保护自己免受潜在的俄罗斯袭击。

sentences.en: So in order to open safe corridors for the grain to leave the port, the Ukrainians will have to remove those mines.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了开辟安全的粮食离港走廊，乌克兰人将必须清除这些水雷。

sentences.en: But in the process, of course, Ukraine would become vulnerable to a possible Russian attack.
sentences.zh: 但在此过程中，乌克兰当然会变得容易受到俄罗斯潜在袭击的攻击。

sentences.en: So if Zelensky were to demine the port, actually putting his country at risk, and in doing so sort of help Europe and the rest of the world in this grain rescue mission,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果泽连斯基去清理港口的水雷，实际上将他的国家置于危险之中，并在此过程中帮助欧洲和世界其他地区完成这项粮食救援任务，

sentences.en: he might be able to get the Europeans to move closer to him on some of his goals.
sentences.zh: 他也许能够让欧洲人在他的一些目标上向他靠拢。

sentences.en: In other words, I help you with the grain, you help me with more weapons or give me more time to fight.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，我帮你的忙运粮食，你帮我提供更多武器或给我更多战斗时间。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Matina, from everything you've laid out here, even with this grain rescue mission, it seems like the Europeans are holding most of the cards.
sentences.zh: 马蒂娜，从你这里列出的所有情况来看，即使有了这次粮食救援任务，似乎也是欧洲人掌握着大部分主导权。

sentences.en: They're the ones with the weapons and the funding.
sentences.zh: 他们是拥有武器和资金的人。

sentences.en: And they're getting impatient.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正在变得失去耐心。

sentences.en: So given how much Ukraine is struggling in the East, it just seems like the momentum is moving toward finding an endgame in the war.
sentences.zh: 因此，考虑到乌克兰在东部的挣扎程度，似乎势头正朝着寻找这场战争的结局发展。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that's right, Sabrine.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为那是对的，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: I think that, sure, there may be a few more chess moves ahead of us in the next few weeks and months.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当然，在接下来的几周和几个月里，我们面前可能还会有更多的棋局移动。

sentences.en: But unless something really, really dramatic changes in the battlefield, the conversation is only going to be going one way.
sentences.zh: 但除非战场发生非常、非常戏剧性的变化，否则对话只会朝着一个方向发展。

sentences.en: And it is probably going the way most Europeans want it to go, which is reconstruction and some form of peace.
sentences.zh: 而且它可能正朝着大多数欧洲人希望的方向发展，那就是重建和某种形式的和平。

sentences.en: But there is a wild card here, and that's obviously Russia.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一个变数，那显然就是俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Any negotiation will have to involve Ukraine and Russia.
sentences.zh: 任何谈判都必须涉及乌克兰和俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And we don't really know if Russia is at all interested in stopping fighting.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道俄罗斯是否有兴趣停止战斗。

sentences.en: We don't know if they need to, if it has reserves, if it has the military capability to continue fighting.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他们是否需要这样做，它是否有储备，它是否有继续战斗的军事能力。

sentences.en: What we do know is that whatever happens and whenever it happens, Europe will have a role to play.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，无论发生什么，无论何时发生，欧洲都将发挥作用。

sentences.en: Russia will want the European Union to lift some sanctions to come to the negotiating table.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯希望欧盟解除一些制裁才能坐到谈判桌前。

sentences.en: And so ultimately, I think what we're looking at here is not a neat sort of quick peace deal.
sentences.zh: 因此，归根结底，我认为我们所看到的不是一个整洁、快速的和平协议。

sentences.en: Rather, it's a sort of prolonged conflict and prolonged diplomatic and political activity that will probably go on for a really long time.
sentences.zh: 相反，这是一种长期的冲突以及长期的外交和政治活动，可能会持续很长时间。

sentences.en: Matina, thank you.
sentences.zh: 马蒂娜，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载纽约时报应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday...
sentences.zh: 在星期三……

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: NATO leaders have just taken decisions to transform and strengthen our alliance at this pivotal time for our security.
sentences.zh: 在我们安全的这个关键时刻，北约领导人刚刚做出决定，以转型和加强我们的同盟。

sentences.en: NATO's secretary-general announced a new vision for the Western Security Alliance, for the first time singling out China as a strategic, quote, challenge.
sentences.zh: 北约秘书长宣布了西方安全同盟的新愿景，首次将中国挑出来作为战略“挑战”。

sentences.en: Today, NATO leaders took the historic decision to invite Finland and Sweden to become members of NATO.
sentences.zh: 今天，北约领导人做出历史性决定，邀请芬兰和瑞典成为北约成员国。

sentences.en: Speaking in Madrid at a gathering of Western leaders, Jens Stoltenberg also announced that the alliance was extending formal membership invitations to Finland and Sweden.
sentences.zh: 延斯·斯托尔滕贝格在马德里举行的西方领导人聚会上发表讲话时还宣布，该同盟正在向芬兰和瑞典发出正式成员资格邀请。

sentences.en: The move paved the way for NATO's most significant enlargement in more than a decade, as the alliance sought to respond to a resurgent and bellicose Russia.
sentences.zh: 此举为北约十多年来最重大的扩张铺平了道路，因为该同盟试图应对一个复苏且好战的俄罗斯。

sentences.en: It is a good agreement for Finland and Sweden, and it is a good agreement for NATO.
sentences.zh: 这对芬兰和瑞典来说是一个很好的协议，对北约来说也是一个很好的协议。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 并且……

sentences.en: Moments ago, R.
sentences.zh: 就在刚才，R·

sentences.en: Kelly was sentenced to 30 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 凯利被判处 30 年监禁。

sentences.en: This is a significant outcome for all victims of R.
sentences.zh: 对于 R·

sentences.en: Kelly, and especially for the survivors who so bravely testified about the horrific and sadistic abuse they endured.
sentences.zh: 凯利的所有受害者来说，这是一个重大的结果，特别是对于那些勇敢地作证讲述他们所遭受的恐怖和虐待的幸存者来说。

sentences.en: A federal judge in New York sentenced former R&B singer R.
sentences.zh: 纽约联邦法官判处前 R&B 歌手 R·

sentences.en: Kelly to 30 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 凯利 30 年监禁。

sentences.en: Last year, Mr. Kelly was found guilty of sex trafficking and racketeering, in what authorities said was a scheme to lure minors into sex that went back decades.
sentences.zh: 去年，凯利先生被判犯有性交易和敲诈勒索罪，据当局称，这是一个可以追溯到几十年前的诱骗未成年人发生性行为的计划。

sentences.en: With the aid of his fame, his money, and most importantly, his inner circle, R.
sentences.zh: 在名气、金钱以及最重要的是他的核心圈子的帮助下，R·

sentences.en: Kelly preyed upon children and young women for his own sexual gratification for decades.
sentences.zh: 凯利几十年来一直为了他自己的性满足而捕食儿童和年轻女性。

sentences.en: He continued committing his crimes for almost 30 years and avoided punishment until today.
sentences.zh: 他继续犯罪近 30 年，直到今天才受到惩罚。

sentences.en: At his sentencing hearing, several of Kelly's victims addressed the court about the effect that that abuse had had on their lives.
sentences.zh: 在宣判听证会上，凯利的几名受害者向法庭讲述了这种虐待对他们生活的影响。

sentences.en: These are voices of mostly black and brown women and children that were heard and believed, and for whom justice was finally achieved.
sentences.zh: 这些主要是黑人和棕色人种妇女及儿童的声音被听到并被相信，正义终于为她们得以伸张。

sentences.en: This is a victory for them, for justice, and for future survivors of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 这对她们、对正义以及对未来性侵犯的幸存者来说是一场胜利。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Ricky Novetzky and Rob Zipko, with help from Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由里基·诺韦茨基 (Ricky Novetzky) 和罗布·齐普科 (Rob Zipko) 制作，威尔·里德 (Will Reed) 提供帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by John Ketchum and Larissa Anderson.
sentences.zh: 它由约翰·凯彻姆 (John Ketchum) 和拉里萨·安德森 (Larissa Anderson) 编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marianne Lozano, Dan Powell, and Rowan Nemisto.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺 (Marianne Lozano)、丹·鲍威尔 (Dan Powell) 和罗恩·内米斯托 (Rowan Nemisto) 的原创音乐。

sentences.en: It was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 它由克里斯·伍德 (Chris Wood) 负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格 (Jim Brunberg) 和本·兰斯福德 (Ben Lansford) 创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格 (Sarah Koenig) 一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
